about: Gates the release evidence report looks up for a release of this repository (release-evidence.mjs). A gate is decided by the newest completed run at the release commit, else on the release-candidate branches. Gates in Atlas-Authorization/pca are looked up at that repository's tag of the same version.
release: atlas-pca and the Python framework adapters (PyPI)

gates.label: CI: verifier on Linux / macOS / Windows, dependency-free verifier, build, adapters
Cross-language gate (this verifier against the other 8)

known_exceptions: The atlas-pca HTTP middleware (require_pca, FastAPI, Django) and the seven framework adapters check the proof only: caveats, replay and revocation are not evaluated by them (https://github.com/Atlas-Authorization/pca/blob/main/docs/maturity.md).
